description: Standardized Mumbai Suburban railway stations with single-digit and decimal multi-gesture station codes for accessible ISL counter kiosks.
delimiter_convention: For branch/trans-harbour decimal codes (e.g. 17.1 for Airoli), sign the major junction (10 + 7) followed by the closed-fist delimiter sign (.) and the branch sub-number (1).
